mechanism: Ginseng may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of atorvastatin, potentially increasing statin levels and myopathy risk; ginseng also has mild antiplatelet effects and may potentiate lipid-lowering effects unpredictably.
action: Monitor patients for statin-related myalgia or elevated CK levels; counsel on consistent ginseng dosing and consider statin level monitoring if high-dose ginseng is used concurrently.
